question: When does season 2 of just add magic come out?
text: Season 2 of *Just Add Magic* is already out. It premiered on Prime Video on **January 13, 2017**, and the second half was released on **January 19, 2018**. ([press.aboutamazon.com](https://press.aboutamazon.com/2016/12/season-two-of-amazon-original-kids-series-just-add-magic-debuts-on-january-13-on-prime-video?utm_source=openai))
